Background
 • Precision/reliability of test scores has been an area
 of active research since the beginning of
 psychometrics.
 • Beyond test scores, data derived from test scores is
 also subject to investigations of precision/
 reliability.
 • In the past several years, the individual student
 growth scores SGPs derived from test data have
 been subject to research regarding precision/
 reliability.

4/25/19 SGP: Precision, Interpretation & Utility 3

SGP SEM Calculation
 • SGP SEMs are calculation using scaled score
 CSEMs provided as part of the state’s assessment
 data used for SGP calculation.
 • Scale scored CSEMs are used to perturb the
 observed scales so that 100 simulated SGPs are
 calculated for each student.
 • The 100 simulated SGPs are used to calculate a
 standard error for each SGP reported.

4/25/19 SGP: Precision, Interpretation & Utility 4

SGP & SGP SEM Facts
 • SGPs, being percentiles, are uniformly distributed.
 • However, the distribution of observed SGPs based
 upon a normal CSEM is normal.
 • That is, a for a student with a true SGP of 50,
 observed SGPs occur most often near 50.
